answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 6022 Country: United Kingdom Title: My question today is as follows: Is it allowed (halal) for a women to breastfeed her child while she is junoob? Or it is necessary to have a shower before any breastfeeding? Question: Salam brothers, My question today is as follows: Is it allowed (halal) for a women to breastfeed her child while she is junoob? Or it is necessary to have a shower before any breastfeeding? Answer ID: 6022 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 664/610=L/1429) A woman can breastfeed her child when she is in a state of impurity ( Janabah) . It is not necessary to have a shower ( ghusl ) before breastfeeding. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
